corrected_content.problem: What is the amplitude of the function $f(x) = \frac{3 - 2\cos x}{13}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution: Rewrite the function as $f(x)=3/13-(2/13)\cos x$. Its amplitude is the absolute value of the cosine coefficient, $2/13$.
